By leveraging innovative lightweight validation techniques and aligned incentives, we're making advanced computer vision accessible and scalable. sources.title: GitHub - score-technologies/turbovision
sources.snippet: TurboVision is Score's decentralized intelligence layer for live video and imagery. The network pairs expert models with a global community of validators and miners so raw footage becomes structured, decision-ready data in real time, with early deployments focused on professional sports.
